paragraphs: Teknoppy is a professional WordPress development company in Kochi delivering custom, mobile-first, SEO-ready WordPress solutions for businesses across Kerala. Since 2018, our in-house developers have completed 120+ WordPress projects — from focused company websites to large-scale WooCommerce stores and multi-language portals.

Every business needs more than a standard website. It needs a fast, credible, search-optimised platform that turns visitors into paying customers. As an experienced WordPress development agency, Teknoppy combines bespoke UI design with custom development, on-page SEO architecture, schema markup, and Core Web Vitals optimisation. Our clients include hospitals, exporters, resorts, retailers, and established enterprises across Kochi, Thrissur, Calicut, Trivandrum, and the GCC.

process.intro: Every WordPress project follows six clear stages, so it is delivered on time, on budget, and built precisely to brief.

steps.title: Discovery & Requirements (Days 1–3)
steps.desc: Detailed stakeholder interviews mapping your business goals, target audience, competitor landscape, and technical specifications.

steps.title: Architecture & SEO Planning (Days 4–7)
steps.desc: We plan your page structure, URLs, and menus so Google can crawl your site easily and each page targets the right search terms.

steps.title: Design & Wireframing (Week 2)
steps.desc: Low-fidelity wireframes approved before development, followed by high-fidelity Figma mockups ensuring zero revision surprises after coding starts.

steps.title: Development & Integrations (Weeks 3–4)
steps.desc: Clean semantic HTML/CSS, mobile-first responsive coding with custom themes, custom post types, and API connectivity.

steps.title: SEO Setup & Content Migration (Week 4)
steps.desc: On-page SEO optimization, schema markup implementation, sitemap generation, and Google Search Console verification for ranking readiness.

steps.title: Testing, Launch & Training (Week 5)
steps.desc: Full cross-browser testing, security hardening, performance verification, DNS cutover, and comprehensive CMS handover training.

faqs.intro: Get quick answers to standard questions about custom WordPress development pricing, process, source code ownership, and technical SEO features.

items.q: What services does your WordPress development company offer?
items.a: Teknoppy provides end-to-end WordPress solutions including bespoke UI/UX web design, custom theme development, WooCommerce online stores, platform migrations, speed optimization, and ongoing monthly maintenance.

items.q: How much does WordPress development cost in Kochi?
items.a: A basic custom WordPress site ranges from ₹40,000 to ₹80,000. Professional corporate sites with 10–20 pages range from ₹80,000 to ₹1,80,000, while advanced enterprise portals and WooCommerce stores range from ₹1,00,000 to ₹4,00,000+. Every project receives a detailed proposal before kickoff.

items.q: Will I own my WordPress website and content?
items.a: Yes. Upon project completion and final payment, you receive full administrator access. The domain, hosting accounts, custom theme code, design assets, and content belong 100% to your company.

items.q: How long does WordPress development take?
items.a: Standard WordPress websites typically launch in 3 to 5 weeks from discovery to final testing. Larger corporate sites with extensive content migration or custom integrations take 6 to 10 weeks.

items.q: Can I edit the website myself after launch?
items.a: Yes. We build with an intuitive visual editor (Gutenberg blocks or Elementor) and provide a personalized training session and handover guide so your team can effortlessly update text, publish blog posts, and add new services.

items.q: Which hosting do you recommend for WordPress?
items.a: We recommend managed cloud WordPress hosting (e.g. Cloudways, Hostinger Cloud, AWS Lightsail) with LiteSpeed or Nginx server caching, automated daily backups, and SSL enabled. We assist you in configuring the right server for your traffic.

items.q: Can you migrate my existing website to WordPress?
items.a: Yes. Our WordPress migration services handle seamless transfers from Wix, Shopify, Squarespace, or legacy HTML platforms, preserving your existing Google search rankings through complete 301 redirect mapping.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Kochi?
items.a: Yes. While our headquarters is in Vyttila, Kochi, we actively work with businesses across Kerala (Calicut, Thrissur, Trivandrum) as well as commercial clients across the UAE, Qatar, and the wider GCC.

items.q: Do you provide website maintenance and support after launch?
items.a: Yes. Our monthly WordPress maintenance plans start from ₹5,000/month, covering core and plugin updates tested on staging, 24/7 uptime monitoring, off-server backups, speed checks, and dedicated developer hours for content updates.
